t: This is Aquaduct, an art installation at the Brunswick Centre. The architect Patrick Hodgkinson designed it. He is best known for designing the Brunswick Centre itself, so this piece sits within his own larger work. It was made by Susanna Heron, a British site-specific artist and jewellery designer recognised for her work in stone relief. Her best known works include Stone Drawing for St John's College, Oxford, and Henslow's Walk at the Sainsbury Laboratory in Cambridge, which won the Stirling Prize in 2012.
